Ever since her daughter became old enough to rule though, she became very laid back and let them do the trouble shooting and solving while she spectated, becoming far less serious and reverting to a halfway between her queenly personality and her adventuring side.

Evergreen Kingdom: Evergreen is a medium sized medieval fantasy city, known for their rambunctious queen, and having the largest supply of Jade steel in the continent, a Metal known for its affinity for magic and mixing well with mana crystals.

World info: Radiant is a large Continent a little bigger than Australia in a fantasy world set near medieval times with different magics and races. There are humans, giant humans, elves of various skin tones, hobbit-esc dwarves, and many demi humans like harpies, lamia, Arachne, werewolves, nekos, lizardfolk, half versions of these races and so on. There are light, dark, blood, arcane, fire, lightning, water, ice, and wind spell types. 
Monsters in this world range from dinosaurs, to draconic creatures, to giant bugs and rare mythical demons.
